name: What types of new flooring materials are recommended for durability and longevity in a high-traffic home?

mainEntity.name: What types of new flooring materials are recommended for durability and longevity in a high-traffic home?

acceptedAnswer.text: For high-traffic areas, durable and long-lasting flooring options include luxury vinyl plank (LVP) or tile (LVT), known for their water resistance and scratch-proof qualities. Porcelain or ceramic tile also offer excellent durability and are resistant to wear, moisture, and stains. Engineered hardwood, with its stable construction, can withstand more fluctuations than solid hardwood. Each option offers different aesthetic and performance benefits, making the choice dependent on your specific needs and preferences.
acceptedAnswer.description: Luxury vinyl, porcelain/ceramic tile, and engineered hardwood are recommended for durability in high-traffic homes.
